extraction.name: Video-MME
extraction.description: The first-ever comprehensive evaluation benchmark of multi-modal LLMs in video analysis
extraction.creator: Chaoyou Fu, Yuhan Dai, Yongdong Luo, Lei Li, Shuhuai Ren, Renrui Zhang, Zihan Wang, Chenyu Zhou, Yunhang Shen, Mengdan Zhang, Peixian Chen, Yanwei Li, Shaohui Lin, Sirui Zhao, Ke Li, Tong Xu, Xiawu Zheng, Enhong Chen, Caifeng Shan, Ran He, Xing Sun
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The construction of the Video-MME dataset involves three main steps: video collection, question-answer annotation, and quality review. Videos are collected from YouTube, covering 6 key domains and 30 subfields. For each category, videos with varying duration lengths are collected, including short (<2 minutes), medium (4-15 minutes), and long videos (30-60 minutes).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw videos are collected from YouTube, along with corresponding meta-information such as subtitles (if provided) and audios.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous manual review process is conducted to guarantee the quality of the dataset. Each QA pair undergoes examination by a different annotator to verify clarity, precision, and logical consistency.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: High-quality question-answer (QA) pairs are annotated to rigorously assess the proficiency of MLLMs in video content interpretation. Annotators with strong English proficiency and extensive research experience in vision-language learning are employed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A rigorous manual review process is conducted to guarantee the quality of the dataset. QA pairs are verified for clarity, precision, and logical consistency.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset underscores the need for further improvements in handling longer sequences and multimodal data, shedding light on future MLLM development.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Known limitations include the decline in MLLM performance as video duration increases, highlighting the need for improving long context modeling capabilities.
